answer: Reference approach for Reflection-Based Inspector: define the contract, implement the behavior in small methods, validate assumptions, and test normal and edge cases. Inspect a known type and report public methods and properties while treating reflection as a tooling feature. Tokens that must appear in one implementation: GetMethods, GetProperties, GetCustomAttributes. Full code should be reviewed and compiled against .NET 10 before publication.
explanation: The implementation should satisfy the objective: Discover types, methods, properties, and attributes. The required-string check is only a smoke check. Correctness requires execution, edge-case tests, and review of error handling and maintainability.
